name: Human Appeal USA
mission:
Human Appeal USA is a non-profit organization working across the globe to strengthen humanity’s fight against poverty, social injustice and natural disaster. Through the provision of immediate relief and the establishment of self-sustaining development programs, we aim to invest in real, effective solutions. 

Human Appeal USA is here for every human. Our work is focused at home as well as abroad, with our ongoing mission of poverty alleviation through dignified means.

dimension_explanations.alignment: This charity is a strong fit for Muslim donors as it is zakat-eligible and follows specific religious guidelines for aid distribution [3]. It addresses urgent humanitarian needs in underserved areas and has a proven track record of delivering relief during Ramadan and winter months [5][9].
dimension_explanations.impact: Human Appeal USA is effective at reaching a high number of people, providing services like cataract surgeries and neonatal care for a cost of about $2.42 per person [6][8]. While its financial health is stable with 10.7 months of cash available, only 50.3% of its FY2024 spending went to programs, which is a point of concern [1]. The group provides clear evidence of its outcomes through detailed impact reports [4][7].

strengths_deep_dive: Human Appeal USA demonstrates strong operational execution in high-conflict and crisis zones. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="2">$35,399,389 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting significant donor trust and rapid organizational growth with a <cite id="2">3-year revenue CAGR of 245.9%</cite>. The charity's direct delivery model allows it to achieve remarkable unit economics, reaching beneficiaries at an average cost of <cite id="4">$2.42 per beneficiary</cite>. In conflict-affected areas such as Gaza, the charity successfully distributed <cite id="4">4,588,281 hot meals</cite> and over <cite id="4">59,369,000 liters of clean water</cite>, while reaching <cite id="4">2,620,000 people through zakat-funded assistance</cite>. Supporting this emergency scale is a resilient balance sheet with <cite id="1">10.7 months of working capital</cite>, giving the organization stability to respond quickly to natural disasters and complex humanitarian emergencies.
rich_narrative.summary: Human Appeal USA is a humanitarian relief organization that delivers emergency assistance, clean water, healthcare, and orphan care to vulnerable populations globally <cite id="3">with a focus on high-conflict zones like Gaza</cite>. Founded in 1991, the organization has built substantial institutional capacity, managing <cite id="2">$35,399,389 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>. That represents rapid expansion from prior years, reflecting a <cite id="2">3-year revenue CAGR of 245.9%</cite>. Human Appeal USA maintains strong operational resilience, holding <cite id="1">10.7 months of working capital in reserve</cite> to ensure continuity during sudden global crises. Their operations deliver direct services with exceptional cost efficiency, averaging approximately <cite id="4">$2.42 per beneficiary</cite> across direct relief efforts. Despite these strengths, donors should note a major financial tradeoff: in FY2024, the charity reported a <cite id="1">50.3% program expense ratio</cite>, which falls significantly below the <cite id="1">75% industry standard benchmark</cite> and the <cite id="1">85.7% peer median</cite>.
